Message:
“Elaine, you were
the one behind all this...?”

I-I was too scared to ask,
but I had to...

“Just breaking apart our bonds
wouldn’t have been enough
to break the ‘door.’
Unless...someone
destroyed it themselves...”

“I did it all to save
the Hero of the Staff.”

but...if you go apologize
to everyone now, maybe...
Eeep!”

E-Elaine’s fingers delved
deep into my chest...
as if trying to grab something...

Elaine had chased after
Solomon by herself.
At that time, maybe she...?

“Heh. That fool has
nothing to do with anything.
I’ve always had this power.”

As she seized my soul,
her gentle whisper
sent shivers down my spine.

“I have a favor
to ask of you.
Would you take me
to ‘Paradise?’”
